authorization: User requested sequential implementation of all five proposed directions; repository standing authorization includes paired GitHub and existing hosted-plugin update.
goal: Improve relevance, observable correctness and evaluation without widening creative scope.
context: Public Studio 1.2.10 source; one state, existing owners and bounded output review.
exclusions: new skill owners or provider integration
hidden learning or automatic prompt adoption
paid model calls without a separately approved budget
source_rules: Primary method papers and current official GEPA API/source
No private context or raw reasoning traces
acceptance_criteria: F01-F03 aligned with active integration policy
Relevant example selection returns at most three compatible cases
Missing or stale evidence never passes a hard requirement
Pairwise evaluation preserves hard gates and handles order disagreement
Reflexion requires a tested correction and explicit scoped adoption
GEPA generates proposals for one section without mutating source
All changes are allowlisted; full package matches both saved destinations

sections.existing_skills: Only correction handling, selected static handoff and conditional links to quality/Reflexion resources
sections.existing_evals: Only expected_owners for H01, H02 and KP02; preserve not_run
sections.reasoning_reference: One conditional quality-method entry, no budget reset
sections.validator: Read-only validation of the new contracts and assets
sections.release_files: Current version marker and one new release entry

scope: deterministic helper defects and negative cases
official GEPA engine with synthetic offline callbacks
fresh text-use checks separately from installed-client behavior
review_packet.stop: Stop when required gates pass; no speculative polish
